mechanics.summary: A player may use archetype or life-path character creation; different players may use different methods if the group agrees, with the Referee having final say.
exceptions: Mixed methods require all players to agree and Referee has final say.

unknowns: Group agreement and Referee approval require input.

mechanics.summary: Hit capacity equals the STR die size plus AGL die size, divided by 4 and rounded up.
trigger: hit capacity is determined or attributes change

outcome.value: ceil((STR die size + AGL die size) / 4)

mechanics.summary: Stress capacity equals the INT die size plus EMP die size, divided by 4 and rounded up.
trigger: stress capacity is determined or attributes change

outcome.value: ceil((INT die size + EMP die size) / 4)

mechanics.summary: Starting group unit morale equals the highest COMMAND skill level among group PCs.

unknowns: Group membership requires input.

mechanics.summary: When following a moral code creates immediate danger or a major sacrifice, the character receives +1 to one related skill roll when applicable and earns 1 XP at session end.
trigger: character follows moral code despite danger or major sacrifice
exceptions: The modifier applies only when it makes sense; the Referee decides when the moral code is tested.

unknowns: Moral-code applicability, sacrifice, and related roll require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Betraying a moral code immediately causes 1 stress and permits replacing that moral code at session end.

unknowns: Betrayal requires player or Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Concrete action toward a big dream can earn extra XP, with the Referee deciding eligibility.
trigger: character takes concrete action toward big dream

unknowns: Concrete action and award eligibility require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Risking life or making a major sacrifice for the selected buddy gives +1 to one related skill roll when applicable and earns bonus XP at session end.
trigger: character risks life or makes major sacrifice for buddy
exceptions: The modifier applies only when it makes sense.

unknowns: Relationship, sacrifice, and contextual applicability require input.

mechanics.summary: The group chooses a number of listed group-gear items equal to the number of PCs, and cannot choose the same item type more than once.

unknowns: Selected group gear requires input.

mechanics.summary: For a starting vehicle, roll 2D6 plus PC count and choose a vehicle in the resulting printed category; it starts alcohol-converted with half a tank.
trigger: group determines starting vehicle by roll
exceptions: A fully civilian group should not start with a military vehicle.
Group and Referee may decide a starting vehicle instead of rolling.

unknowns: Vehicle selection and civilian-group determination require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: At the end of character creation, roll D6 to determine starting permanent radiation points.

outcome.value: permanent radiation points equal D6 result

mechanics.summary: Archetype characters begin C in all attributes, make three one-step increases, and may gain one additional increase by reducing one C attribute to D.

value.optionalIncrease: one for reducing C to D

mechanics.summary: An archetype character selects one B skill, two C skills, and three D skills; the B skill must be listed by the archetype, while C and D choices are unrestricted.
exceptions: Only the B skill must be an archetype-listed key skill.

mechanics.summary: An archetype character selects one specialty from the archetype options, or any specialty if the Referee allows it.
exceptions: Any specialty outside the archetype options requires Referee permission.

unknowns: Referee permission requires input.

mechanics.summary: A life-path character starts age 18 with CUF D and C in all four attributes, then rolls 2D3 for attribute increases; reducing one C attribute to D adds one increase and attributes cannot exceed A.
Life-path creation rolls D6 for childhood, selects one listed childhood skill at D, then rolls D6 for one listed specialty; either roll may be chosen if the Referee allows it.
exceptions: Choosing instead of rolling requires Referee permission.

unknowns: Referee permission and selected options require input.

mechanics.summary: Each career term increases two eligible skills one step each or one eligible skill two steps. A new skill begins at D and no skill can exceed A.
exceptions: Stamina, Mobility, and Driving are always eligible.
First military term requires one increase in Ranged Combat.

unknowns: Career selection and eligibility require data.

mechanics.summary: After career skill increases, make one unmodified unpushable roll using an increased skill. Success grants a D6 career specialty; military promotion increases rank one step, and military or intelligence promotion increases CUF one step to A maximum.
trigger: life-path career term skill increases complete
exceptions: The player may choose specialty if the Referee allows it.

unknowns: Career type and Referee choice permission require input.

mechanics.summary: After each term, age D6 years and roll D8; if the D8 result is below completed terms, reduce one chosen attribute one step, minimum D. No age reduction occurs after first term.
exceptions: No attribute reduction after the first term.

mechanics.summary: After each term, a D8 result below completed terms starts the war and proceeds to the At War term; otherwise select another career term.

value.belowTerms: war begins; resolve At War term

mechanics.summary: The At War term increases two different chosen skills one step each and grants one final specialty from the printed last-career column; no promotion roll follows.
exceptions: Re-roll a specialty already known; selection instead of rolling requires Referee permission.

unknowns: Last-career category and Referee permission require input.

mechanics.summary: A non-local whose final pre-war civilian term was not Intelligence is drafted or volunteers for the At War term: one skill increase must be RANGED COMBAT unless already D or better, specialty uses Military column, and starting gear uses Combat Arms.
trigger: life-path character enters At War term after qualifying civilian career
exceptions: Intelligence careers are excluded from the draft condition.

unknowns: Local status and career category require input.

mechanics.summary: For local militia, war automatically starts after first term; character gains one military-table term plus At War benefits, knows the area, has multiple contacts and a home there, and speaks local language fluently.

outcome.value: war after first term; add At War benefits and local knowledge/contact/home/language facts

unknowns: Local area and contact details require campaign data.

mechanics.summary: At session end, award 1 XP for each qualifying printed question answered yes, maximum one XP per question; the group discusses unclear awards and the Referee decides unresolved cases.

questions: acted toward big dream with risk or sacrifice

unknowns: All XP criteria need group or Referee adjudication.

mechanics.summary: XP can be spent only during a shift spent resting or sleeping.

outcome.value: block XP spending outside resting or sleeping shift

unknowns: Rest or sleep state requires input.

mechanics.summary: Increasing one skill step costs XP by target level (D 5, C 10, B 15, A 20); increases are one step at a time, and gaining D costs 5 XP.
trigger: character spends XP to learn or improve skill

mechanics.summary: To gain D in a skill or increase its level, character must have used and succeeded at least once with it since last increase, or have been instructed for one shift by a teacher with a higher level.
trigger: character spends XP to learn or improve skill
inputs: successful meaningful skill use since last increase

outcome.value: block increase unless use-success or qualifying instruction recorded

exceptions: Only meaningful rolls with something truly at stake count; Referee decides.
Instruction is an alternative to a roll.

unknowns: Meaningful use, success, and teacher qualification require history and Referee input.

mechanics.summary: A specialty costs 10 XP and requires a PC or NPC teacher who knows it to instruct for at least one shift; then the teacher rolls PERSUASION. Failure teaches nothing that shift, keeps XP, and permits another attempt another shift.

unknowns: Teacher identity, specialty knowledge, and time require input.

mechanics.summary: After a session with a successful CUF roll, roll the CUF base die; a 1 increases CUF one step, maximum A. Each CUF increase requires an EMP base-die roll; 6+ permanently reduces EMP one step, minimum D.
trigger: session ends after successful CUF roll

unknowns: Successful CUF roll history requires tracking.

mechanics.summary: At session end, unit morale increases one step if one or more listed positive events occurred, or decreases one step if one or more listed negative events occurred; it remains between F and A.

unknowns: Event assessment is a group procedure.

mechanics.summary: After a session in which the character betrayed their moral code, they may replace it with a new one.
A character may replace their big dream after any session.
After a session, a character may choose another PC as buddy, but can have only one buddy at a time.

values.selectionRule: one selection per PC; no duplicate type
values.options: backpack; bow with D6 arrows; pistol or shotgun with D3 reloads; sniper/hunting rifle with D3 reloads; LMG/GPMG with belt; GL/ATRL with D3 reloads where applicable; D6 magazines/reloads; two machinegun belts; D6 launcher reloads; D6 grenades; dirt bike half tank; toolkit; binoculars; D100 liters fuel; D6 medkits; D6 food rations; D6 water rations

referenceData.notes: Each row supplies printed candidate D-level skills and D6 specialty list.
Career rows provide static prerequisites, skill options, specialty D6 results, and starting gear used by life-path procedures.
At War specialty column is selected by most recent career term.
